application: Parking occupancy detection from a bay magnetometer (FOURTH simulated application; flood warning first, outage detection second of the simulations)
data_nature: Fully SYNTHETIC traces generated by gen_trace() in this script (seeded). No field data.

generator.sampling: 1 Hz, 21,600 samples (6 h) per trace, single bay
generator.channel_note: deviation of the measured field vector from the device's causal gated-EMA empty-bay baseline (tau 1800 s, adapts only while |dev| < 1.0 uT); features scaled x0.1 (10 uT = 1.0) for the encoder; the rule consumes the same deviation magnitude unscaled
generator.background: field magnitude 42-58 uT, per-trace direction, slow drift +/-0.4 uT (sinusoids + clipped walk), noise sigma 0.15 uT/axis

events.occupancy: step 3-14 uT (log-uniform), own-bay axis cone, 10-240 min (log-uniform), gaps 20-90 min — GROUND TRUTH
events.neighbour: sustained 1.5-5 uT, different axis, 10-180 min, Poisson(1.2)/trace — NOT occupancy
events.passing: raised-cosine 3-12 uT, 2-8 s, own-bay-like direction, Poisson(3)/trace — NOT occupancy
events.transient: single-axis spike 2-6 uT, 1-3 s, Poisson(6)/trace — NOT occupancy

generator.ground_truth: occupancy state = 1 exactly on injected own-bay intervals; window label = state at final timestep

model.encoder: SemanticEncoder MLP 64->48->24->8 tanh (architecture unchanged from the flood build)
model.training: joint end-to-end; int8 quantisation in the loop (STE); latent noise sigma=0.03 in training; pos-weighted BCE + 0.05*MSE(recon); Adam lr 1e-3, batch 256, early stop on val F1 (patience 8, max 40 epochs) — flood recipe verbatim

rule_baseline.rule: study stage3.rule_above imported as-is, on the deviation magnitude series
rule_baseline.report_layout: event type 1 B, onset timestamp 4 B, min/max deviation 4 B, duration 2 B, flags/confidence + header/CRC 9 B (study's 20 B semantic-report budget)

payload_comparison.nn_latent: 8 int8 values = 8 bytes per evaluated window

bytes_per_day_simulated.cadence: one 16-sample window evaluated per minute (1,440 windows/day); raw and learned transmit per evaluated window; rule transmits one 20 B report per episode edge (arrival and departure)
